fusions.name: Shut Tight
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the bite. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Surfacing Bite
fusions.desc: Lunges you onto a target up to 6 tiles away for a bite that deals 13 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 40% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung From Below
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to bury a nest at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it and leaves the enemy [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Letting It Work
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
